title: CineStream - Remove FeaturedRow overlay scroll buttons

requirements.summary: Remove left/right overlay scroll buttons from FeaturedRow while preserving native horizontal scrolling and tightening layout spacing.
acceptanceCriteria: In `frontend/src/components/FeaturedRow.tsx`, the left and right navigation `<Button>` elements (ChevronLeft/ChevronRight) are no longer rendered.
The FeaturedRow content remains horizontally scrollable using native scrolling (e.g., touch swipe/trackpad) with `overflow-x-auto` preserved.
No unused imports or dead code remain in `FeaturedRow.tsx` (e.g., remove `Button`, `ChevronLeft`, `ChevronRight`, and the `scroll` callback if no longer used).

After removal, the FeaturedRow layout has no empty reserved space that previously accommodated the buttons (adjust any horizontal padding such as `px-12 sm:px-16` as needed so cards align naturally within the container).

file_operations.description: Remove the overlay navigation UI (left/right ghost Buttons and Chevron icons) and the now-unneeded scroll handler/ref logic; keep the row natively horizontally scrollable by preserving `overflow-x-auto` on the scroll container and remove/adjust horizontal padding (e.g., drop `px-12 sm:px-16`) so cards align naturally without reserved button space. Ensure imports are cleaned up and no dead code remains.
